en_before: Punk makeup doesn't exist separately from fashion. It works best alongside pieces with a similar language: graphic tees, leather, faded denim, metal hardware, boots and disrupted silhouettes. For fashion foundations, see the Punk / Grunge hub; this article focuses on makeup.
